mapper.select: select snapshot_id, stat_date, region_code, dispatch_company_count, employer_count, dispatched_worker_count, high_risk_enterprise_count, insurance_rate, aq_insurance_rate, today_warning_count, expand_completion_rate, new_injury_rate, online_device_count, pending_warning_count, overdue_injury_count, source_mode, remark from t_cockpit_snapshot where region_code = #{regionCode} and stat_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by stat_date asc

select feature_id, stat_date, region_code, feature_type, feature_name, geometry_type, geometry_json, feature_status, source_mode, properties_json, sort_no from t_cockpit_map_feature where 1 = 1
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
and stat_date = ifnull(#{statDate}, (select max(stat_date) from t_cockpit_map_feature)) order by sort_no asc, feature_id asc

select count(1) from t_warning where date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{statDate}
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')

select count(1) from t_warning where warn_status in ('0', '1', '4')
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')

select count(1) from t_device where device_status = '1'
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')

select count(1) from t_injury_event where remaining_days < 0 and injury_status in ('0', '1', '2', '3') and del_flag = '0'
and region_code like concat(#{regionPrefix}, '%')
